edits.question: do you have showers
edits.draftText: I do not have that in your coach's notes yet.
edits.editedText: Yes. There are two showers next to the locker room. Bring your own towel and a lock.

edits.question: Can I bring a friend to my session?
edits.draftText: I do not have that in your coach's notes yet.
edits.editedText: Yes, once a month you can bring a friend for free. Tell me a day ahead so I can plan the session for two.

edits.question: Should I wear a lifting belt for squats?
edits.draftText: I do not have that in your coach's notes yet.
edits.editedText: You do not need a belt on this program yet. Learn to brace first. We will add a belt once your working sets pass your bodyweight.

edits.question: how do I reset my app password
edits.draftText: I do not have that in your coach's notes yet.
edits.editedText: On the login screen tap Forgot password and enter your email. You get a code by email to set a new one.

edits.question: Is there a sauna at the gym?
edits.draftText: I do not have that in your coach's notes yet.
edits.editedText: There is no sauna here. The closest one is at the rec center next door.
